# Christopher Farlow - Professional Profile

## Overview

**Current Title:** Partner at Sequoia Commercial Lending, Inc.[1][3]

**Organization:** Sequoia Commercial Lending, Inc., a commercial real estate financing firm headquartered in Beverly Hills, California[1]

**License Status:** California Real Estate Salesperson (License ID: 02031979, current as of the provided data with expiration date 12/05/25)[4]

## Background

Christopher Farlow serves as a partner at Sequoia Commercial Lending, working in commercial real estate financing and debt placement.[2][3] He has been involved in structuring complex commercial real estate transactions, including securing pre-approvals for high-leverage financing arrangements. In one notable transaction, he helped secure an 85% leverage pre-approval for an office property financing deal.[2]

His professional mailing address is listed as 24442 Los Serranos Dr, Laguna Niguel, CA 92677.[4]

## Education

The search results do not contain information about Christopher Farlow's educational background, degrees, or institutions attended.

## Sequoia Commercial Lending, Inc. - Company Profile

### Overview

Sequoia Commercial Lending was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Beverly Hills, California at 441 N Beverly Dr Suite 200.[1][4] The firm specializes in structured financing for commercial real estate owners throughout California.[1]

### Products & Services

The company specializes in debt and equity placement ranging from $1 Million to $100 Million.[1] They have financed over 500 properties since inception, demonstrating substantial market experience.[1]

### Leadership

The management team includes:[3]
- Christopher Farlow (Partner)
- Brett Twente (Partner)
- Luke Goedecke (Commercial Loan Broker USA)

### Recent Mentions

Farlow was cited in a 2015 GlobeSt.com article discussing an office property that secured 90% LTV financing, where he described pre-approval arrangements allowing for 85% leverage.[2]
